databaseDataSourceConfig.sqlQuery:
select jp.id,jp.code,cartridge_model,cartridge_combo,jp.title_en,jp.brand ,jp.sales, jp.bsr,substr(title_en, 0,80) short_title
from paihao_competitive_product_data as jp
inner join (
	SELECT distinct
			id jpid,
			unnest(string_to_array(replace(title_en,',',' '), ' ')) as printer_model
	FROM paihao_competitive_product_data
	WHERE country ={{country}} and brand not in ('COLORETTO','COCCINK','Penguin','Cyloral') 
			AND monthly = CONCAT({{year}}, '-', LPAD({{month}}, 2, '0'))
			AND ({{cartridge_model}} is not null and cartridge_model = {{cartridge_model}})
			and ({{cartridge_combo}} is not null and cartridge_combo={{cartridge_combo}})
) tmp on tmp.jpid=jp.id and tmp.printer_model={{printer_model}}
ORDER BY {{sort}}
limit {{limit}} offset {{offset}}
databaseDataSourceConfig.datasourceName: 打印机错位流量分析总表-右

databaseDataSourceConfig.sqlQuery:
select * from
	(
	select 
		printer_series,
		cartridge_model,
		printer_model,
		cartridge_combo,
		cast(sum(maket_hits)/NULLIF(count(distinct jpid), 0) as DECIMAL(10,0)) maket_hits,
		cast(sum(maket_purchase_quantity)/NULLIF(count(distinct jpid), 0) as DECIMAL(10,0)) maket_purchase_quantity,
		cast(sum(maket_purchase_quantity)/NULLIF(sum(maket_hits), 0) * 100 as DECIMAL(10,2)) exchange_rate,
		count(distinct jpid) jpcount,
		row_number() over (order by cartridge_model,printer_model,cartridge_combo,sum(maket_purchase_quantity) desc) as idx
	from
		(
		select
			distinct hot.cartridge_model,
			hot.printer_model,
			sw.printer_series,
			sw.maket_purchase_quantity,
			sw.maket_hits,
			sw.maket_exposure,
			sw.search_word,
			jp.cartridge_combo,
			jp.jpid
		from
			paihao_hot_model as hot
		left join paihao_search_term as sw on hot.search_word_id = sw.id and hot.country = sw.country
		left join (
			select 
				id jpid,
				country,
				monthly,
				cartridge_model,
				cartridge_combo,
				unnest(string_to_array(replace(title_en,',',' '),' ')) as printer_model
			from
				paihao_competitive_product_data
			where
				country = {{country}}
				and brand not in ('COLORETTO', 'COCCINK', 'Penguin', 'Cyloral')
				and monthly = CONCAT({{year}}, '-', LPAD({{month}}, 2, '0'))
		) jp on
			hot.country = jp.country
			and TO_CHAR(hot.report_date, 'YYYY-MM')= jp.monthly
			and hot.cartridge_model = jp.cartridge_model
			and jp.printer_model = hot.printer_model
		where
			TO_CHAR(hot.report_date, 'YYYY-MM')= CONCAT({{year}}, '-', LPAD({{month}}, 2, '0'))
			and hot.country= {{country}}
			and jp.printer_model <> ''
			and ({{cartridge_model}} is null or {{cartridge_model}} ='' or hot.cartridge_model in (NULLIF({{cartridge_model}},'')))
			and ({{cartridge_combo}} is null or {{cartridge_combo}} ='' or jp.cartridge_combo in  (NULLIF({{cartridge_combo}},'')))
			and ({{printer_model}} is null or {{printer_model}} ='' or hot.printer_model in  (NULLIF({{printer_model}},'')))
		) as distinct_data
	group by
		cartridge_model,
		printer_model,
		cartridge_combo,
		printer_series
) as tmp
order by {{sort}} limit {{limit}} offset {{offset}}
